scope: Primary sources; true electric pickup DI, matched weak/medium/strong performances, independent labels, fixed gain and no normalization/compression, clear access/license
interpretation: No candidate was verified to satisfy all requirements; unknown is not a negative claim. Neither MIDI velocity nor RMS is assumed to be physical force.
